description: Irish soil percolation tests are paired with saturated-hydraulic-conductivity estimates from HYDRUS 2D for onsite wastewater-treatment assessment. This resource is provided by Laurence Gill. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Measured falling-head values and modelled conductivity must remain distinct. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
